name: Altar
ability: Each night*, choose a dead player: tonight, they have their ability as if they were alive.
flavor: The ofrenda: their photo, their favourite bread, a glass of what they liked to drink. Come home for one night.
otherNightReminder: The Altar chooses a dead player: mark them REMEMBERED. Tonight that player has their ability as if alive; wake them at their usual time.

name: Candle
ability: Each night*, choose a living player: if they die tonight, they keep their ability while dead.
flavor: A candle in the window, so they can find their way back.
otherNightReminder: The Candle chooses a living player: mark them CANDLE. If they die tonight, mark them LIT: they keep their ability while dead.

name: Marigold
ability: While you are alive, dead players don't use up their vote when they vote.
flavor: Cempasúchil. Follow the orange petals from the graveyard to the door.

name: Guide Dog
ability: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): if the Demon attacks them tonight, you die instead, and learn who the Demon is.
flavor: The Xoloitzcuintli walks you all the way to Mictlán. A good one bites on the way.
otherNightReminder: The Guide Dog chooses a player: mark them GUARDED. If the Demon attacks them, the Guide Dog dies instead: wake them and point to the Demon.

name: Monarch
ability: Each night*, you learn how many dead players are evil.
flavor: La monarca arrives every year at the start of November. Count them carefully.
otherNightReminder: Show the Monarch how many dead players are evil.

name: Incense
ability: Your living neighbours can't be drunk or poisoned.
flavor: Copal smoke keeps the bad air away from the altar.

name: Poet
ability: Each day, you may publicly recite a calavera (a short, funny poem) about a living player. Tonight, you learn if they are evil.
flavor: Here lies poor Beto, who swore he was good. The Demon laughed louder than anyone should.
otherNightReminder: If the Poet recited a calavera today, mark that player VERSE and tell the Poet if they are evil (thumbs down) or not (thumbs up).

name: Paper Cutter
ability: You start knowing 3 good characters that are not in play.
flavor: Papel picado, cut so finely you can see right through it.
firstNightReminder: Show the Paper Cutter 3 good character tokens that are not in play.

name: Photograph
ability: On your 1st night, choose a player: you learn their character. Each night*, you learn if their character or alignment has changed.
flavor: The picture never changes. The person might.
firstNightReminder: The Photograph chooses a player: mark them PORTRAIT and show their character token.
otherNightReminder: Nod if the PORTRAIT player's character or alignment has changed since the Photograph chose them, shake your head if not.

name: Woodcarver
ability: Each night, you have the ability of a good character not in play (the Storyteller's choice). You learn which.
flavor: Tonight's alebrije is part jaguar, part eagle, part whatever the carver dreamed last night.
firstNightReminder: Choose a good character not in play: show its token to the Woodcarver. They have that ability tonight.
otherNightReminder: Choose a good character not in play: show its token to the Woodcarver. They have that ability tonight.

name: Abuela
ability: You start knowing a good player and their character. If they die, you learn an evil player that night.
flavor: She knows every grandchild by name. She has opinions about the new boyfriend.
firstNightReminder: Point to a good player and show their character token. Mark them FAMILY.
otherNightReminder: If the FAMILY player died since last night, point to an evil player. Remove FAMILY.

name: Baker
ability: Each night*, choose a dead player: you learn their character, and they learn yours.
flavor: Pan de muerto for the departed. They brought the coffee.
otherNightReminder: The Baker chooses a dead player: show the Baker their character. Wake that player and show them the Baker token, pointing to the Baker.

name: Sugar Skull
ability: If you are dead, you may still nominate.
flavor: Your name in icing on the forehead. Dead? Yes. Done? Absolutely not.

name: Fright
ability: Each night, you must choose a living player: they are drunk until dusk tomorrow.
flavor: Susto: a fright so bad your soul jumped out. It has to land on somebody.
firstNightReminder: The Fright chooses a living player: mark them DRUNK.
otherNightReminder: The Fright chooses a living player: mark them DRUNK.

name: Glutton
ability: While you are alive, dead players' abilities don't work.
flavor: The tamales were for the ancestors. Were.

name: Mourner
ability: If you are executed, the Demon may kill an extra player tonight.
flavor: The plañidera is paid to weep at funerals. Tonight she weeps at her own.

name: Restless Soul
ability: If you die, you return to life at dawn, but you are evil. You learn who the Demon is.
flavor: An alma en pena. Some souls go home on the second of November. This one came back wrong.
otherNightReminder: If the Restless Soul died since last night: wake them, show thumbs down and point to the Demon. At dawn they are alive again. Mark EVIL.

name: Shapeshifter
ability: Each night, choose a player: until dusk, you register as their character and alignment.
flavor: The nahual: by day a neighbour, by night a jaguar wearing the neighbour's face.
firstNightReminder: The Shapeshifter chooses a player: mark them SHAPE. The Shapeshifter registers as that character and alignment until dusk.
otherNightReminder: The Shapeshifter chooses a player: mark them SHAPE. The Shapeshifter registers as that character and alignment until dusk.

name: Will-o'-Wisp
ability: Each night, choose a living player: until dusk, they are drunk and register as dead.
flavor: Follow the little light into the trees. In the morning you'll still be standing there; you just won't be home.
firstNightReminder: The Will-o'-Wisp chooses a living player: mark them LOST. They are drunk and register as dead until dusk.
otherNightReminder: The Will-o'-Wisp chooses a living player: mark them LOST. They are drunk and register as dead until dusk.

name: Dark Rider
ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned until dusk tomorrow. If they are dead, they also lose their vote.
flavor: El Charro Negro offers you a ride home. Do not get on the horse.
firstNightReminder: The Dark Rider chooses a player: mark them POISONED.
otherNightReminder: The Dark Rider chooses a player: mark them POISONED. If they are dead, remove their vote token.

name: Soul Thief
ability: Each night*, choose a dead player: you learn their character. If the Demon dies, you become the Demon.
flavor: He doesn't steal the candles or the bread. He steals who they were.
otherNightReminder: The Soul Thief chooses a dead player: show their character token.

name: Gatekeeper
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Players you kill lose their vote, and can't regain their ability.
flavor: He guards the gate of Mictlán. Every soul passes it eventually. He just prefers sooner.
otherNightReminder: The Gatekeeper chooses a player: they die. Mark them CLAIMED: remove their vote token; they cannot be REMEMBERED or LIT.

name: Ossuary
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If a good player was executed today, choose 2 players instead.
flavor: Every bone in here has a name. Every mistake the living make adds another.
otherNightReminder: The Ossuary chooses a player: they die. If a good player was executed today, they choose 2 players instead.
